item.title: [GOOD] BSEC Chair to Lead New Tk1,700cr Market Stabilisation Fund
item.description:
Category: Good

After a 26-month delay, the Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) Chairman will now lead the board overseeing a new Tk 1,700 crore market stabilization fund. This fund is intended to provide much-needed liquidity and confidence to the capital market.

Why this matters: The activation of a substantial market stabilization fund after a long delay is a positive step for market confidence and liquidity.
